description: Starting ranges + every decision node for a flop spot. In the response each node has `node`, its path (e.g. root/CHECK), and `token`; pass `token` as the `node` argument of flop_node. Charges 1 presolved quota. Single-street (for turn/river use the solver tools).

flop_version.description: flop dataset id, same values as preflop_versions; omit for the default dataset (6max). Some boards have no data in the default dataset: the call returns 404 and still charges 1 presolved quota, so retry with a flop_version

positions.description: roles→positions. SRP: {hero,raiser,caller}; 3BET/4BET: {hero,raiser,three_bettor}; LIMP: {hero,limper} (hero or limper must be BB)

name: flop_tree
title: Flop decision tree
